text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom and Dad, it feels like the craze 
around me melted away right along with the 
spring snow. The stands were dead quiet."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I can't stay down in the dumps! 
This time, I'm gonna start another boom 
all on my own through my runnin'!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Just as I was getting pumped, I saw that 
girl (you know who) looking down. I just 
couldn't bear to watch her like that..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Even though we're rivals, I told her I'm 
rooting for her. I just know she'll show 
us that sparkling, starry running of hers 
again!"
